    • 字段详细资料

      • autoPause

        @NameInMap(value="AutoPause")
public Boolean autoPause

        Specifies whether to enable the smart pause and start feature for the Serverless instance. Valid values:

        • true: enables the feature.
        • false: disables the feature. This is the default value.

        This parameter is required only for MySQL and PostgreSQL Serverless instances. If no connections are established within 10 minutes, the instance enters the paused state. When a connection is established, the instance is automatically awakened.

        example:

        true

      • maxCapacity

        @NameInMap(value="MaxCapacity")
public Double maxCapacity

        The maximum number of RDS capacity units (RCUs) for automatic scaling. Valid values:

        • MySQL: 1 to 32
        • SQL Server: 2 to 16
        • PostgreSQL: 1 to 14

        The value of this parameter must be greater than or equal to the value of MinCapacity, and only integers are supported.

        example:

        8

      • minCapacity

        @NameInMap(value="MinCapacity")
public Double minCapacity

        The minimum number of RCUs for automatic scaling. Valid values:

        • MySQL: 0.5 to 32
        • SQL Server: 2 to 16 (integers only)
        • PostgreSQL: 0.5 to 14

        The value of this parameter must be less than or equal to the value of MaxCapacity.

        example:

        0.5

      • switchForce

        @NameInMap(value="SwitchForce")
public Boolean switchForce

        Specifies whether to enable forced elastic scaling for the Serverless instance. Valid values:

        • true: enables the feature.
        • false: disables the feature. This is the default value.
        • This parameter is required only for MySQL and PostgreSQL Serverless instances. After you enable this feature, the instance may be unavailable for 30 to 120 seconds during forced scaling. Use this feature with caution based on your business requirements.
        • Elastic scaling of RCUs usually takes effect immediately. However, in some special cases (such as during the execution of large transactions), scaling cannot be completed immediately. In this case, you can enable this parameter to force scaling.
        example:

        false
